reviewed_by: Codex review of nebula-v3.0.14 native command release failure
reason: The v3.0.14 real-Core gates exposed native command parsing of appended Core instructions, stale Guides and top-bar action entry under Quiet Lens, fourteen Core journeys that assumed an older shell, and goal controls covered by the collapsed conversation rail. A separate goal-panel release failure used an opener that a responsive rerender had already replaced with the open panel. Select the focused command unit file, production LAN real-Core commands and Guides on desktop and 390 px Chromium/WebKit, Quiet Lens mock journeys on desktop and mobile Chromium/WebKit, the fourteen exact failing Core desktop journeys, four additional assistant desktop goal/Guide journeys, and three goal-panel revision cases. The shared AppShell and TopBar impact was reviewed against their rendered menu workflow.
exclusions: No focused component test covers the shell menu interaction and no native source changed, so frontend unit and native selections are empty; the real-Core and mock browser journeys exercise the rendered state. Unrelated browser and backend journeys are excluded. The selected browser entries collect thirty-four cases; a full suite was not requested.
